notes: Scripts: 'The king's escalation ladder' and 'The king quest'. ladder.ts walks the rungs; quest.ts runs gathering, battle, election. Both gated by features.ladder / features.quest until the battle and promotion passes.

nobles.wants: Nothing. The king wronged him and he cannot be bought back. The most reliable ally in the game.
Silver. Can be outbid by the king, which is a mid-quest crisis.
A promise of estates when the player is crowned.
Chancellor, marshal, a bishopric: cheaper than land, paid after winning.
A match into the player's house: an unmarried lord. A lord already married into a great house (Theoderada) has her brothers instead, near-certain; any other wife shuts this door.
Nothing: he is repaying. Famine relief, a ransom paid, a lawsuit backed, a son placed at Auxerre.
Reassurance. He does not love the player; he thinks the king is worse, or fears a disputed succession more.
A man who will actually fight. Strong pitch from a player who made his name against Northmen.
nobles.requires: saint_florentin_888 or argenteuil_898 or march_886 == 'commanded' or irregular_tactics >= 2 or renown >= 1000

nobles.wants: Nothing but the appearance of blessing. Church standing, relics, abbeys, surviving what killed others.

crown.cost: Works, and sets a taint: simony
Works now; the Church is an enemy for the rest of the reign
